title: Ononin promotes bone marrow-derived mesenchymal stem cells survival via SIRT6/Nrf2 signaling for myocardial infarction repair.
authors: Hu, Changlei; Xu, Tong; Xu, Honglin; Pang, Mingjie; Zhang, Guoyong; Han, Xin; Zhang, Jiayi; Liu, Mengqi; Hua, Yue; Chen, Guanghong; Zhong, Binglian; Deng, Bingying; Tu, Yuanyu; Chen, Tiantian; Hu, Shuqi; Liu, Bin; Zhou, Yingchun
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Ononin通过SIRT6/Nrf2信号通路保护骨髓间充质干细胞以修复心肌梗死，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Myocardial infarction (MI) induces significant myocardial damage through oxidative stress and inflammation, limiting the survival and effects of transplanted bone marrow-derived mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs). Stem cell-based therapies hold promise for cardiac repair; however, enhancing BMSC survival under adverse conditions remains a critical challenge. Strategies to mitigate oxidative stress and apoptosis in transplanted BMSCs can significantly improve therapeutic outcomes. PURPOSE: This study investigated, for the first time, the protective effects of Ononin, a natural isoflavone, on BMSC survival and function under oxidative stress conditions, both in vitro and in a murine MI model, with a specific focus on the novel mechanism of action via the SIRT6/Nrf2 signaling axis. METHODS: The effects of Ononin on BMSCs were assessed under oxidative stress conditions induced by tert‑butyl hydroperoxide (TBHP). Cellular oxidative stress and apoptosis were evaluated by flow cytometry, fluorescence staining, and Western blotting assay. Additionally, antioxidant enzyme expression and pathway activation were analyzed using qPCR, immunofluorescence, and Western blotting assay. Moreover, molecular docking, Drug Affinity Responsive Target Stability Assay (DARTS), cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), and surface plasmon resonance (SPR) verified the direct interaction of Ononin with SIRT6. In vivo, Ononin-pretreated BMSCs were transplanted into the mouse MI model, and their survival, along with therapeutic outcomes such as myocardial inflammation, fibrosis, apoptosis, angiogenesis, and cardiac function, was assessed using bioluminescence imaging. Additionally, siRNA-mediated knockdown of SIRT6 was employed for investigating SIRT6/Nrf2 pathway in Ononin's protective effects. RESULTS: In vitro, Ononin pretreatment mitigated oxidative stress and apoptosis in TBHP-treated BMSCs, and up-regulated antioxidant enzyme levels by activating SIRT6/Nrf2 signaling pathway. Molecular docking, DARTS, CETSA, and SPR analyses confirmed the direct interaction of Ononin with SIRT6. In vivo, bioluminescence imaging revealed that Ononin-pretreated BMSCs exhibited enhanced survival after they were transplanted into the MI mouse model. According to the therapeutic outcomes, myocardial inflammation, fibrosis, and apoptosis were alleviated, and angiogenesis and cardiac function were improved. Importantly, knockdown of SIRT6 partially reversed these effects, underscoring the novel effect of SIRT6/Nrf2 pathway on regulating Ononin's protective actions. CONCLUSION: This study demonstrates that Ononin enhances the survival of transplanted BMSCs and improves myocardial repair by targeting the SIRT6/Nrf2 signaling pathway. These findings provide a promising pharmacological strategy to optimize stem cell-based therapies for MI.
abstract_zh: 背景：心肌梗死（MI）通过氧化应激和炎症诱导显著的心肌损伤，限制了移植骨髓间充质干细胞（BMSCs）的存活和效果。基于干细胞的疗法有望用于心脏修复；然而，在不利条件下增强BMSCs存活仍是一个关键挑战。减轻移植BMSCs氧化应激和凋亡的策略可显著改善治疗结果。目的：本研究首次探讨了天然异黄酮Ononin在氧化应激条件下对BMSCs存活和功能的保护作用，涵盖体外实验和小鼠MI模型，并特别关注其通过SIRT6/Nrf2信号轴的新型作用机制。方法：在叔丁基过氧化氢（TBHP）诱导的氧化应激条件下评估Ononin对BMSCs的影响。通过流式细胞术、荧光染色和Western blotting检测细胞氧化应激和凋亡。此外，使用qPCR、免疫荧光和Western blotting分析抗氧化酶表达和通路激活。同时，分子对接、药物亲和响应靶标稳定性分析（DARTS）、细胞热位移分析（CETSA）和表面等离子体共振（SPR）验证了Ononin与SIRT6的直接相互作用。在体内，将Ononin预处理的BMSCs移植到小鼠MI模型中，并通过生物发光成像评估其存活以及心肌炎症、纤维化、凋亡、血管生成和心脏功能等治疗结果。此外，采用siRNA介导的SIRT6敲低来研究SIRT6/Nrf2通路在Ononin保护作用中的角色。结果：在体外，Ononin预处理减轻了TBHP处理的BMSCs中的氧化应激和凋亡，并通过激活SIRT6/Nrf2信号通路上调抗氧化酶水平。分子对接、DARTS、CETSA和SPR分析确认了Ononin与SIRT6的直接相互作用。在体内，生物发光成像显示，Ononin预处理的BMSCs在移植到MI小鼠模型后表现出增强的存活。根据治疗结果，心肌炎症、纤维化和凋亡得到缓解，血管生成和心脏功能得到改善。重要的是，SIRT6敲低部分逆转了这些效应，强调了SIRT6/Nrf2通路在调节Ononin保护作用中的新作用。结论：本研究证明，Ononin通过靶向SIRT6/Nrf2信号通路增强移植BMSCs的存活并改善心肌修复。这些发现为优化基于干细胞的MI疗法提供了一种有前景的药理学策略。
